title: Akasha Yoga Montreal
specs: Prenatal and postnatal yoga taught by a birth doula with childbirth education
Ambient room temperature studio, not hot yoga
Retreats include yoga, mindfulness, journaling, nature immersion, and sound journey
Minimum age to practice yoga is 16 years old
Students must provide valid student ID for student pricing
Seniors must be 65+ with valid government ID for senior pricing
Please remove jewelry if possible for Reiki sessions
Advise if sensitive to scents for Reiki sessions
Private classes, private group classes, and corporate classes available by email request
Studio rental capacity: 8 people for small workshops, 30+ for big studio
includes: Yoga mats and props included for postnatal yoga classes
gap: Duration of most regular yoga classes not stated
blurb: Akasha Yoga Montreal offers yoga classes including prenatal and postnatal yoga, wellness treatments such as Reiki, and studio rental. Prenatal and postnatal yoga classes focus on physical and emotional support during pregnancy and early parenthood. The studio also hosts retreats and offers private and corporate classes.
extraNote: All passes and services are non-transferable and non-refundable after purchase · Membership auto-renews after 1 year with $5/month increase unless cancelled 1 month before renewal · Pause membership for 1 month with 1 week written notice · Late cancellation fee $10 for members, loss of class for drop-ins and class cards
